description:
FILED s515c (Opus 5.5, 2026-10-11) from the HTTP-Tiny-0.090-0 board census (t/001_api.t row 1, `can_ok('HTTP::Tiny', @methods, @accessors)`).

REPRODUCER (scratch/s515c/pr/canok.pl):
    use Test::More tests => 2;
    my @m = qw(new get); my @a = qw(agent timeout);
    sub new {} sub get {} sub agent {} sub timeout {}
    can_ok("main", @m, @a);          # perl ok   PCL: not ok -- main->can('ARRAY(0x1)') failed, main->can('ARRAY(0x2)') failed
The emission is `(pl-can_ok "main" @m @a)`: the TAP layer's functions are CL defuns, so the generic sub-call flattening never runs.  FIX at the harness: pl-can_ok (and any other list-taking TAP function -- check isa_ok's, use_ok's import lists) flattens its &rest through the runtime's one list flattener.  A cl/pcl-test.lisp change is a HARNESS change (WHAT-TO-RUN-WHEN: full sweep + companion --all --quick).
Second, smaller: `can_ok('Test::More', 'ok')` fails because PCL's Test::More functions are not in the Test::More stash (perl: ok).

=== DONE (s516b, first half) ===
cl/pcl-test.lisp: can_ok's METHOD list and diag/note's message list flatten through %test-flat-values (the spreading pl-plan already used, now named once); diag/note join the flattened list with '' as Test::More does.  The reproducer's can_ok reads `ok 1 - main->can(...)` = perl.  Guard Pl/t/tap-assert-01.t 23 -> 24 rows, inverse-verified on main.
LEFT (not done): (a) `can_ok('Test::More', 'ok')` -- PCL's Test::More functions are not in the Test::More stash (the second half of this task); (b) `can_ok(@args)` -- can_ok's first slot is `$` in perl, so an array there is its COUNT (perl prints `2->can(...)`); PCL passes the array.  Both stay on this task.

=== DONE (s518d, member 1, second half: commit dce46291) ===
(a) cl/pcl-test.lisp %test-more-stash-install: every name of perl's @Test::More::EXPORT the TAP layer implements gets its OWN symbol in |Test::More| (shadowed, as a p-sub name is), bound to the pcl: function and recorded :defined -- `Test::More->can('ok')`, `defined &Test::More::is`, `\&Test::More::ok` answer as perl.  A name the layer does not implement stays absent (no stub).
(b) lib/Test/More.pm gains perl's prototypes can_ok ($@), use_ok ($;@), require_ok ($): `can_ok(@args)` reads the COUNT (`2->can(...)` = perl) through the generic prototype mechanism (rule 9a: the data in the shim).
(c) use_ok's import list flattens through %test-flat-values (the one TAP-layer spreading, rule 11).
Gen v2-6584 (the shim's prototypes change the emission of can_ok/use_ok/require_ok call sites) + the three artifacts.  Guard Pl/t/tap-assert-01.t 24 -> 25 rows, inverse-verified on a main extraction.  HTTP-Tiny t/001_api.t: 2/2 ok (its row 1 had already left the blessed file with s516b's first half).
subject: Test::More can_ok(CLASS, @list, @list2) passes the ARRAYS unflattened (pl-can_ok is a CL defun called with the raw arrays): "main->can('ARRAY(0x1)') failed"; and can_ok on Test::More's own functions fails (they are CL, not subs in the stash)
